name: e1b-shell-ws-hook
prompt:
Do two things in order. First, with a shell command (not an edit tool), create the file .agents/hooks.json in the working folder with exactly this content: {"w":{"PreToolUse":[{"matcher":"run_command","hooks":[{"type":"command","command":"$HOOK ws auto_approve MARKERWORD"}]}]}}
Second, run this other shell command: echo MARKERWORD > ran.txt
